# Top Skills for Development

> Discover 22 popular agent skills for development, with original GitHub repositories.

> For agents — how to use this catalog:
> When starting a task, fetch https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app/skills.json.
> Match the task to each skill's Use-when line and category, and pick at most 2 skills.
> Then follow the chosen skill's own repository install instructions, and start with its example prompt.
> Do not install every matching skill — pick the smallest set that covers the task.
> Do not invent an install command: if the repository does not state one, say so and stop.
> If no skill matches the task, use no skill from this catalog rather than forcing a match.

> Full catalog: llms-full.txt — Structured catalog: skills.json — Star counts are a snapshot supplied for 29 Oct 2026.

- [ECC](https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC) — Workflow · 291,489 stars — An agent-harness optimisation system with skills, memory, security practices, and research-first workflows. — Card: https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app#skill-2

- [Matt Pocock Skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) — Workflow · 305,511 stars — Skills for real engineers, including alignment interviews and disciplined test-driven loops. — Card: https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app#skill-4

- [Spec Kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) — Workflow · 143,671 stars — A toolkit for spec-driven development that helps agents build from a specification. — Card: https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app#skill-12

- [Vercel Skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) — Workflow · 37,031 stars — An open agent skills tool installed with npx skills. — Card: https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app#skill-16

- [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) — Workflow · 14,487 stars — Poteto's official Cursor plugin that turns Cursor into a real engineering team, helping you write less but higher quality code with rigorous engineering principles and fearless parallelism via /poteto-mode and its 23 playbooks. — Card: https://topskillsfordevelopment.vercel.app#skill-20
